interface.title: Melt Curve Viewer
interface.field: Molecular biology / qPCR (SYBR melt-curve analysis, Bio-Rad CFX Maestro exports)
interface.stage_of_work: Quality control and interpretation of qPCR results after the run
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a CFX Maestro melt-curve RFU export (plus an optional sample-name file), plot every well's raw melt curve or its -d(RFU)/dT derivative, and pick wells from a searchable, sortable table to compare Tm and find problem wells.

data.note: Melt_Curve_RFU_Results.txt (tab-delimited, 12 wells A01–A12, 65–95 °C) went into upload box 1 and was confirmed as 'Loaded … 12 wells'. Melt_Curve_Peak_Results.txt went into box 2 and was confirmed as '12 sample names': Sample_1_Rep1..4 (A01, A06, A07, A11), Sample_2_Rep1/2, Sample_3_Rep1/2, Sample_4_DoublePeak (A04), NTC (A05), Sample_5, Sample_6_Weak (A12). A06 has a missing point at 80 °C. Right after the first upload the plot stayed empty even after Select All and ticking rows, because the raw-RFU box is ticked by default and the derivative plot does not draw while A06 is included. It first drew when the box was unticked.
